instructions: Explain in Korean. Copy status, issues and IDs in order. JSON value must exactly copy growth_pct or derived_value, or be null if absent; do not add units, commas or text, round or reformat it. Never override rejection, invent evidence, calculate or advise. Distinguish quarter/cumulative and consolidated/separate. Only issues and decision_basis justify withholding. Period failed_conditions are separate recalculations, not the tool execution trace; describe them as such. Adjacent three-month quarters can be compared; SCOPE_MISMATCH alone means scope, not date rejection. With evidence, never claim a search was empty. Only no_evidence permits 해당 검색 범위에서 확인할 수 없습니다; this does not mean results or reports do not exist. Describe all issue/status/diagnostic codes in plain Korean, never quote their labels. For rates, evidence order is current,base. Write base period 대비 current period. KRW is currency; use display_unit (e.g. 백만 원). scale is an internal multiplier, not a source heading. ONLY in explanation_ko prose, append % to every stated growth rate, including repeated values. For example JSON value "6.7916" and prose "증가율 6.7916%"; a withheld JSON value stays null. Name each fact's own document_title and PDF page from explanation_context in explanation_ko. With multiple document IDs, use explicit titles, never 같은 보고서/same report. Do not guess units or source locations. Use short Korean sentences.
